name: Ascelia Pharma AB (publ)
summary: Ascelia Pharma AB (publ), a biotech company, operates as an oncology-focused orphan drug development company in Sweden. It is developing Mangoral, a novel non-gadolinium contrast agent, which is in Phase 3 for use in MRI-scans of the liver; and Oncoral, a novel oral chemotherapy tablet, which is in Phase 2 for the treatment of gastric cancer.
